lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular clusters organized in three primary horizontal rows between the mid-lateral and dorsal carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal carinae to form a lattice; spots are centered within the resulting rectangular cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient (high luminance above, deep shadow below) extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance spots localized primarily to the base and lower posterior margin of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly reflective white pigmentation patch on the distal tip of the ventral caudal lobe.
